hotels.title: Sri Lanka Beachfront Bliss on Pasikuda Bay with Daily Breakfast, Massages & Free-Flow Cocktail Hours
hotels.description: Experience the serene beauty of Sri Lanka's eastern coast at this luxury beachfront hotel in Pasikuda. Enjoy a three-kilometre stretch of private beach, world-class scuba diving and snorkelling nearby, fine dining and fresh seafood at the signature restaurant, a unique underground spa with skilled Balinese therapists, and exhilarating water sports. The resort's architectural elegance combines Mediterranean charm with tropical simplicity, which makes for the perfect elevated yet laid-back beach escape. Set along the pristine shores of Pasikuda Bay, known for its gentle waves and shallow waters, experience the bliss of wading waist-deep to the coral reef's edge or diving under the waves alongside colourful marine life.
